about_heading_sr: Senior Software Engineer | Backend Architect | DevOps & Platform Engineering | Drupal & WordPress Expert
about_intro: Hello, I'm Juan José Gómez López. I am a Senior Software Engineer and Backend Architect based in Cuernavaca, Mexico, dedicated to designing, scaling, and optimizing complex enterprise web platforms for global organizations.
about_welcome: Welcome to my personal slice of the web (which, keeping things fast and lightweight, is built statically with Hugo).
about_scale_p1: With over 9 years of full-stack development experience, my career has been defined by turning intricate business requirements into high-availability digital infrastructures. I specialize deeply in the PHP ecosystem, particularly in architecting enterprise solutions using Drupal (versions 7 through 11) and WordPress.
about_scale_p2: I have a proven track record of designing multisite architectures and high-availability systems. Whether it's executing zero-downtime migrations for tens of thousands of users, or building complex synchronization systems that process massive transactional queues, my goal is always to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient platforms.
about_philosophy_title: The Engineering Philosophy: From Enterprise to Micro-Frameworks
about_philosophy_p1: My background in electronics instilled in me a fundamental appreciation for how things work "under the hood." This drives my approach to software architecture: choose the right tool for the job.
about_philosophy_p2: While my day-to-day often involves heavy-duty enterprise environments and cloud infrastructures (AWS, Acquia, Pantheon), I am equally passionate about minimalism in code. When the project calls for it, I love building with lightweight tools like FlightPHP and SQLite to create highly efficient, resource-conscious software.
about_devops_p1: An application is only as good as the infrastructure it runs on. A significant part of my focus is on platform engineering, system integration, and DevOps. I am continuously modernizing legacy deployment workflows, leveraging Docker and transitioning to modern self-hosted deployment platforms like Dokploy to establish true cloud-native infrastructure.
about_devops_p2: Beyond traditional web architecture, I actively explore the intersection of backend engineering and AI. I regularly utilize machine learning libraries like MLX and run models like LLaMA and Qwen locally to automate tasks and accelerate my development workflows.
about_connect_p1: I am always looking toward the next architectural challenge and strongly prefer collaborating with international teams in remote environments.
about_connect_p2: Whether you want to discuss enterprise CMS architecture, the nuances of local LLM deployment, or just share a great cup of coffee (preferably espresso with perfectly textured micro-foam), I'd love to hear from you.
